Qoo10 Japan Shoppers Can Now Try On Color Lenses and Scan Their Skin with Perfect Corp. AI

More than 30 million registered Qoo10 Japan users now have access to Perfect Corp.’s AI and AR beauty tools on their phones. The rollout covers two of the platform's key beauty categories: color contact lenses and skincare.

, a global leader in AI, AR and agentic AI solutions for beauty, fashion, and retail, today announced that its AI Skin Analysis and AR color contact lens virtual try-on are now available on Qoo10 Japan, the online marketplace operated by eBay Japan. Shoppers can try on color lenses on product pages and scan their skin with a smartphone camera to get product recommendations matched to their needs.

Buying color contacts and skincare online usually means guessing. A lens color that looks right in a product photo can look different on the eye, and choosing skincare often means reading through long lists of products and reviews. Perfect Corp.'s AI and AR technology lets Qoo10 Japan shoppers check both before they buy.

Color contact lenses are one of the few beauty products customers cannot test before buying: once a pair is opened, it cannot be returned, and the same lens can look different depending on a person's natural eye color. Since August 2026, Qoo10 Japan app users have been able to open the camera on a color lens product page and see the lens on their own eyes in real time.

AI Skin Analysis, now available in Qoo10 Japan's beauty category, starts with a smartphone photo. Before the scan, the camera checks lighting, face angle, and face position to make sure the image is usable. The AI then scores 10 skin concerns: moisture, oiliness, pores, acne, texture, redness, radiance, firmness, wrinkles, and dark circles.
Ready to Use for Brands on Qoo10 Japan

Both tools run inside Qoo10 Japan's existing product pages, so brands do not need their own app or technical integration to offer them. For skincare and color lens sellers, this puts the try-on and skin check right where shoppers decide what to add to their cart.

"With AR try-on and AI skin analysis now on Qoo10 Japan, shoppers can see how a color lens looks on their own eyes and which skincare fits their skin before they pay," said Alice Chang, Founder & CEO of Perfect Corp. "For brands, that means customers who understand the product before they buy, and a way to offer personalized service on every product page without building their own tools."
About Qoo10 Japan
Operated by eBay Japan, Qoo10 Japan is an online marketplace dedicated to delivering a fun and enjoyable shopping experience.

Launched in 2010, Qoo10 Japan offers a wide range of products across various categories, including fashion, beauty, sports, electronics, mobile accessories, daily necessities, home and living, food, baby products, entertainment, books, e-tickets, and more.
Through Qoo10 Japan, sellers, including both businesses and individuals, can freely list products from Japan and overseas, while buyers can enjoy shopping in a safe and secure online environment.

これまでの実態調査では、「AI」を謳いながら実態が伴わないケースや、逆に「AI」を謳わずに本格的な機械学習を内包しているケースを見てきた。今回は少し違う発見があった。同じ資生堂グループの中でも、サービスが始まった時期によって「AI」という言葉の使い方が変わっているのだ。本記事では、エリクシール AIスキンアナライザー、Perfect Corp(YouCam)、肌パシャの3サービスを、「AIの裏付けの厚さ」と「時代によるAI訴求の変化」という切り口で、私なりに整理してみた。
比較早見表(2026年8月20日確認時点)

エリクシール AIスキンアナライザー:資生堂研究所の皮膚科学研究にもとづく「独自のAIプログラム」を搭載し、顔写真から目の下のたるみ・ほうれい線・目もとのシワなど全16項目を測定・分析すると公式発表されている。「たるみ」を正面と上向きの顔形状の差分から評価する方法は資生堂研究所が特許を取得している。皮膚科学・ライフスタイル研究にもとづくAIチャット機能も搭載・Perfect Corp(YouCam):公式プレスリリース(2022年9月14日)によれば、Wake Forest School of Medicine皮膚科教授のDr. Steven R. Feldman氏による研究で、「AI deep learning technology」の精度が検証されている。プレスリリースは同一デバイスでの再現性(test-retest reliability)についてICC>0.90・95%という高い数

2017年開始の肌パシャは「独自の技術」「画像処理技術」という表現にとどまっていたが、2024年開始のエリクシール AIスキンアナライザーでは「AIが顔写真を立体的に解析」「独自のAIプログラム」とAIを前面に押し出している。同じ資生堂グループでも、サービスが立ち上がった時期によってAIという言葉の使い方が明確に変わっている、という点は興味深い発見だった。これは肌パシャの技術水準を否定するものではなく、あくまで打ち出し方の時代的な違いだと理解してほしい

Trying on New Glasses While Wearing Your Own: Explaining Generative AI's "Glasses Removal"

On October 26, 2026, Perfect Corp. announced the launch of a new feature called "Glasses Removal" for its "AI Virtual Try-On" service, powered by generative AI. This feature removes the glasses currently being worn from the image and redraws the hidden eye area and skin, allowing users to try on new frames without having to take off their current ones.

In this article, we will first look at how virtual try-on overlays glasses onto a face, and then consider the difficulty of "removing and redrawing glasses" and how we should interpret the redrawn eye area.
Virtual try-on works by capturing the position and orientation of the face from camera footage and overlaying the glasses image in sync with those movements.
With glasses removal, generative AI erases the glasses being worn, redraws the hidden eyes, eyebrows, skin, and lighting, and then overlays the new frames.
The redrawn eye area is a "plausible estimation" and not a capture of your actual eyes. Numerical data on the accuracy of this reproduction has not been published.
